system.description:
If an adversary within Melee range shifts their focus away from you, describe how you impede them and make a Reaction Roll using an appropriate Trait against theim. Choose an effect on a success, or two on a critical:

  • They can't move, or you move with them.
  • You deal your weapon damage to them.
  • You set them up, making them Vulnerable.

You may replace an Archetype Feature with a Duelist Style. See Appendix for Duelist Styles.
